title: Define and Query Searchable Business Data
readerIntent: Add searchable behavior to an existing business schema through the supported source contracts.
priorKnowledge: Know the owning module, schema, permissions, and expected query use cases.
owner: Owning business module and Nodics search capability
summary: Declare index ownership beside the business capability, keep engine options in provider configuration, and verify query and indexing boundaries.

sections.heading: Before implementation
items: Identify the authoritative schema and stable record identity.
List searchable fields, filters, sorting, pagination, and aggregation needs.
Define tenant, enterprise, catalog, ownership, and permission boundaries.
Choose indexing triggers, refresh expectations, and outage behavior.

sections.heading: Implementation path
items: Add the index definition to the owning module under src/search/indexes.js.
Keep schema and index field definitions aligned.
Use provider-neutral search services and secured routes.
Configure engine endpoints, credentials, aliases, and provider options outside business source.
Regenerate affected search services, routes, tests, OpenAPI, and AI context.

sections.heading: Verification
items: Valid filters, sorting, pagination, and empty results.
Invalid query shape and unsupported properties.
Unauthorized and cross-tenant access.
Create, update, delete, and bulk index synchronization.
Provider outage, stale data, cache interaction, and recovery.
Normal schema save and update regression behavior.

sections.heading: Example goal
paragraphs: Make Enterprise searchable by code, description, active state, Tenant, and approved hierarchy fields. Employees see only Enterprises permitted by their resolved tenant and groups.
Search supports friendly BackOffice selection while Profile remains the record authority.

sections.heading: Define the search contract
items: Stable document identity and source schema version.
Indexed and stored fields with safe display rules.
Text analyzers, exact filters, sorting, pagination, and aggregation requirements.
Mandatory tenant and permission filters.
Index trigger, expected lag, delete behavior, and rebuild plan.
Fallback and outage behavior.

sections.heading: Customize and extend safely
paragraphs: Select the provider through the search capability. Endpoints, credentials, TLS, aliases, analyzers, and engine tuning belong in provider configuration and secret management.
Do not embed local Elasticsearch paths or credentials in reusable source. A new engine implements the normalized provider contract.

sections.heading: Index representative records
items: Create Enterprises in two tenants.
Index through normal authoritative lifecycle hooks.
Update code or description and observe consistency behavior.
Deactivate or delete a record and verify removal policy.
Run a bulk import and finalization or reconciliation.
Rebuild the index from authoritative records.

sections.heading: Query from BackOffice
paragraphs: Authenticate an employee, discover the Enterprise model, and search by friendly terms. Confirm code and bounded description display while the full description remains accessible.
Select a result and retrieve it through Profile. Search does not supply edit permission.

sections.heading: Negative and resilience tests
items: Unknown field, unsupported operator, excessive page size, and malformed query.
Wrong-tenant, unauthorized field, and protected aggregation.
Stale mapping, unavailable provider, timeout, and partial bulk failure.
Duplicate delivery, retry, delete, and reconciliation.
Cache isolation and invalidation.
Normal schema update with search disabled.

sections.heading: Operational handoff
items: Document index ownership, mappings, aliases, provider configuration, and secrets.
Define latency, freshness, capacity, and availability objectives.
Monitor health, lag, rejection, retry, and resource use.
Provide reindex, restore, rollback, and incident procedures.
Record limitations and provider maturity.
Keep tutorial, technical reference, and generated contracts current.
